integrity: Analytical two-term Stirling expansion and global tail bounds give the asymptotic; standalone numerical checker verifies selected parameters but is not a substitute for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic only for fixed positive annular area and first-Hermite window; no explicit finite onset radius, unique maximizing index, or higher-window claim. Prior-art priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: The lower-shoulder selection law for thin first-Hermite localization annuli
